tokens.name: bcc-true-black
tokens.usage: Logo, statement slides, display type, body text on Paper Cream (20.6:1).

tokens.name: bcc-cream
tokens.usage: Primary light surface — the brand's paper. Never pure white.

tokens.name: bcc-cream-warm
tokens.usage: Warmer alternate light surface for photo-heavy or editorial pages.

tokens.name: bcc-off-white
tokens.usage: Rarely-used off-white variant; prefer bcc-cream for surfaces.

tokens.name: bcc-white
tokens.usage: Card fill (bg-card) where a surface needs to sit above Paper Cream.

tokens.name: bcc-cobalt
tokens.usage: Primary accent — links, primary CTAs, use-case fields. 6.1:1 on Paper Cream; Paper Cream on Cobalt is also 6.1:1.

tokens.name: bcc-dark-cobalt
tokens.usage: Shadowed/pressed variant of Cobalt for statement backgrounds.

tokens.name: bcc-cobalt-tint
tokens.usage: Lighter Cobalt tint for hover states and tinted fields.

tokens.name: bcc-sky
tokens.usage: Soft blue accent used sparingly, mostly as strokes — not a text color.

tokens.name: bcc-crimson
tokens.usage: Dark red editorial/serif tone and data-heading color; statement backgrounds (Paper Cream reads 14.7:1 on it).

tokens.name: bcc-red-warning
tokens.usage: Red-zone / do-not markers. On Paper Cream this is 3.9:1 — use at 19px+ bold or 24px+, or as an icon/marker rather than small body text.

tokens.name: bcc-red-warm
tokens.usage: Warm secondary red for editorial accents distinct from the warning red.

tokens.name: bcc-lemon
tokens.usage: Lemon Lime — high-visibility 'Infinite Possibilities' callouts and poster fields. Pair with true-black text (17.6:1), never used as text itself.

tokens.name: bcc-forest
tokens.usage: Deep forest green counterpoint field for posters and use-case blocks (Paper Cream reads 11.7:1 on it).

tokens.name: bcc-orange
tokens.usage: Secondary accent orange; use sparingly, never alongside another accent.

tokens.name: bcc-orange-2
tokens.usage: Near-duplicate of bcc-orange kept for source fidelity; prefer bcc-orange for new work.

tokens.name: bcc-peach
tokens.usage: Soft peach tint for large, quiet fields behind editorial imagery.

tokens.name: bcc-peach-soft
tokens.usage: Deeper peach tint, a step warmer than bcc-peach.

tokens.name: bcc-gray-900
tokens.usage: Near-black dark surface (bg-ink-2), slightly softer than true black.

tokens.name: bcc-gray-850
tokens.usage: Dark neutral between gray-900 and gray-800 for layered dark surfaces.

tokens.name: bcc-gray-800
tokens.usage: Dark neutral for raised elements on a black ground.

tokens.name: bcc-gray-700
tokens.usage: Secondary text (fg2) on Paper Cream — 13.5:1 — and stroke-medium.

tokens.name: bcc-gray-600
tokens.usage: Mid-dark neutral for borders or muted dark-mode text.

tokens.name: bcc-gray-500
tokens.usage: Mid-gray neutral, between gray-600 and gray-400.

tokens.name: bcc-gray-400
tokens.usage: Tertiary text (fg3) on Paper Cream — 5.2:1, meets body-text contrast.

tokens.name: bcc-gray-300
tokens.usage: stroke-hairline; also muted text on dark grounds (6.9:1 on true-black).

tokens.name: bcc-gray-250
tokens.usage: Near-duplicate of gray-300 kept for source fidelity.

tokens.name: bcc-gray-200
tokens.usage: stroke-soft — quiet dividers and card borders, not for text.

tokens.name: bcc-gray-100
tokens.usage: bg-muted — quiet fill for inactive UI, not for text.

tokens.name: fg1
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on Paper Cream or white surfaces.

tokens.name: fg2
tokens.usage: Secondary text on Paper Cream or white surfaces — captions, metadata.

tokens.name: fg3
tokens.usage: Tertiary text on Paper Cream or white surfaces — timestamps, helper text.

tokens.name: fg-inverse
tokens.usage: Text and icons on ink, Forest, or Crimson grounds.

tokens.name: fg-accent
tokens.usage: Links and accent text on Paper Cream or white surfaces.

tokens.name: fg-warning
tokens.usage: Warning/do-not text — see bcc-red-warning's note on contrast at small sizes.

tokens.name: bg-paper
tokens.usage: Default light surface for nearly every content page.

tokens.name: bg-paper-warm
tokens.usage: Alternate light surface for imagery-forward sections.

tokens.name: bg-ink
tokens.usage: Default dark surface — section openers, statement pages, the BuilderCallout band.

tokens.name: bg-ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary dark surface, one step off true black, for layered dark UI.

tokens.name: bg-card
tokens.usage: Card fill where a surface needs to read as raised above Paper Cream.

tokens.name: bg-muted
tokens.usage: Quiet fill for inactive or secondary UI elements.

tokens.name: bg-cobalt
tokens.usage: Cobalt statement/poster field.

tokens.name: bg-dark-cobalt
tokens.usage: Shadowed Cobalt statement field.

tokens.name: bg-lemon
tokens.usage: Lemon Lime statement/poster field — pair with true-black text.

tokens.name: bg-forest
tokens.usage: Forest statement/poster field — pair with Lemon or Paper Cream text.

tokens.name: bg-crimson
tokens.usage: Crimson statement field for editorial/serif-toned moments.

tokens.name: stroke-strong
tokens.usage: High-emphasis borders — primary buttons, focus rings.

tokens.name: stroke-medium
tokens.usage: Standard control borders (inputs, ghost buttons).

tokens.name: stroke-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet card and section dividers.

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: Decorative hairline rules — not a meaning-carrying control border.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Special Gothic Condensed, bold weight, all-caps. Very tight leading — hero statements and titles.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: h4 / slide title — set in uppercase.

groups.name: Body
groups.note: GT Standard — the workhorse sans for all running copy.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Lead paragraphs and hero support copy.

groups.name: Mono
groups.note: GT Standard Mono — eyebrows, S-codes, the bottom meta strip, and [bracketed] labels, always uppercase.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Eyebrows and section labels — set uppercase.

styles.name: mono-sm
styles.usage: Page numbers and the meta strip — set uppercase.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tightest gaps — icon-to-label, inline chip padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Compact gaps within a control.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gaps between small clustered elements (form rows, button groups).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default inline gap and small card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Stack gaps between related blocks of copy.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gaps between grid items (pillar cards, poster blocks).

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Page/slide margin — the base padding on every container.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section-to-section spacing on content pages.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Large top/bottom padding on hero and pillar sections.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Widest section padding — poster and callout bands.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Square corners — the default for photos, buttons, and small chips.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Buttons and small chips.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Photos, inputs, and poster blocks in applied UI.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Nested cards inside a large slide or container.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The signature slide/card radius — deck chrome and top-level containers.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Large-format containers that want an even softer edge than radius-lg.

tokens.name: shadow-inset-soft
tokens.usage: The stamped, printed-paper depth on poster blocks. The system otherwise avoids shadows.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: The only outer shadow in the system — a 1px hairline lift, used sparingly.

meta.note: Distilled from the BCC Brand Guidelines V.01 (Feb 02 2026) — a Figma brand deck, no shipped product UI.
